description: M4-08: incremental decoding in the streaming trust layer. Default frame route (decode at end of utterance) vs opt-in incremental route (search while frames arrive, finalize at end). Equality of final decisions, end-of-utterance latency, per-frame push cost, provisional top-1 stability. CPU only.

b2t.data: Brain-to-Text '25 copy task (Card et al. 2024, T15, CC0): the 816 split-A test trials as full-precision NTS JSON Lines written by M4-06
b2t.decoder: experiments/2026-11-10-b2t25-trust Decoders: phoneme CTC prefix beam (vector, beam 64, n_best 20, prune_logp -8, space rules, no LM) -> PhonemeWordDecoder (CMUdict, word unigram, char 6-gram; tuned lm_weight 1.0 / edit_penalty 12 / word_bonus 3)
b2t.caches: the word decoder caches (_cand_cache, _lm_cache) are cleared at the start of each condition and kept across the trials of a condition (as in a live session)

synthetic.decoders: greedy; demo segment beam (ReferenceDecoder + RefCharLM 5-gram, beam 8); CTC prefix beam RETUNED (vector, beam 256, n_best 20) + Tatoeba char 6-gram

timing: time.perf_counter around each StreamingTrustLayer.push; end of utterance = push of the end event (stream build + frame temperature + decode or finalize + trust core); no ledger
